findings.issue: The metric called recall_at_3 is any-relevant-document hit rate. On multi-document questions it does not measure fraction/all required sources; labeled_support accepts one matching passage while critical_fact is the completeness gate. Fresh manifest documents this and provides supplemental all-document coverage.
findings.suggestion: Use precise labels in published metrics: any-hit@3, single-passage support, and complete critical facts. Display supplemental multi-document coverage and0/2 completeness; do not present partial support as complete multi-document answering.
